title: Policy Service Guidance: Ending, Restoring and Expiring Rental Reimbursement Coverage
content:
**Rule.** The Rental Reimbursement Coverage is terminated only when the vehicle's physical damage coverage has been removed, terminated or expired. It is restored when that coverage is restored and expires with the owner term. A removal at the named insured's request takes effect on the date requested, never earlier; losses before the removal keep their eligible period.

## 1. Termination and restoration follow the physical damage coverage

The test reads the status of the vehicle's own physical damage coverage — the one the rental coverage is attached to — on the company's records before the termination is made.

| Status of that physical damage coverage | Rental coverage may be terminated |
|---|---|
| Removed | Yes |
| Terminated | Yes |
| Expired | Yes |
| Any other status | No |

When that physical damage coverage is restored, the rental coverage is restored with it.

## 2. Removal at the named insured's request

The named insured may have the coverage removed, whether it is still scheduled or already active. The removal takes effect on the date requested, never earlier. A loss that occurred before the removal keeps its eligible period.

## 3. Status of a rental coverage

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Scheduled | Added, effective date not yet reached |
| Active | The effective date has been reached |
| Removed | Removed at the named insured's request, before or after it started |
| Terminated | The coverage ended because the vehicle's physical damage coverage or owner term ended |
| Expired | The coverage expired with the owner term |

A terminated coverage returns to active when the physical damage coverage is restored.

## 4. Cases (hypothetical)

- The vehicle's physical damage coverage has been removed. The rental coverage on that vehicle may be terminated.
- The vehicle's physical damage coverage is still active. The rental coverage is not terminated under this rule.
- A named insured asks for removal as of a hypothetical date Q, and a covered loss had occurred on the day before Q. The removal takes effect on Q, and that loss keeps its eligible period.
